notes.title: Card Hog art update
notes.notes:
Hello, snout kickers!

Hope you're doing well! I wanted to drop in and let you know that my upcoming dungeon crawler Card Hog just got a huge art upgrade and an updated demo for you to check out! 

A lot more polish, music, sounds, new cards and game modes are coming soon too as I'm working as hard as I can to make that little card game as fun as it can be.

https://i.imgur.com/ENMOyms.gif

Don't forget to add it to your wishlist or you might miss the Early Access which should start in a month or two. I would love to make it happen next month, but don't want to promise and fail to deliver.

Also, your user tags are very helpful for Steam algorithm to figure out what kind of game it is and start recommending it where it should! Add some of those, if you can. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1186120/Card_Hog/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11538937/2cbeae3bfe72262de0640a34a7876651c2fb9d22.gif

If you'll have time to check out the demo, I would like to hear some feedback! What did you like? What was missing? What could be improved? I know cards lack descriptions, but they with a lot more UX polish are coming in the following updates.

Cheers!

Feedback thread:

notes.title: Bacon May Die: plans & Android release
notes.notes:
Hurray! We did it! Or, more correctly, you did it! My new Bacon May Die game got Greenlit in 9 days! Pleasantly surprising! Can't thank you enough, but I can write up a general roadmap for it. 

Android release
I'm currently working on new enemies and mechanics, which I test in Android version. If you can download it, it would be awesome to hear what you think about it: 
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.snoutup.baconmaydie



Bacon May Die Steam
For Steam I'm thinking about going through Early Access with this, because I believe a lot of cool things could be added with the help and ideas from community. This way I could bring the game to you faster, cheaper and have an excuse for any issues you might encounter, while I work on fixing them.

If you played Android version, you might notice it has both auto-aim and auto-running enabled. The plus side is that keeping controls that simple in PC release too would allow me to have 2-3 player local co-op modes easily without a need of controllers, but I'm gonna need your input on that. Another option would be making co-op modes with simpler controls and allowing full movement in single player.

There's no schedule, but I plan starting closed PC version testing in a few weeks and hoping to release Early Access version before summer ends.



How can you help?
Here are some ways you could help me get this game faster to Steam:

* Play Bacon May Die on Android, share it around and let me know what you think about it
* Suggest new enemy types, melee weapons, guns, spells and character outfits
* Follow me on Twitter - I'll share beta keys there!
* Play Iron Snout and suggest it to your favorite youtubers or streamers when they look for new games (always awesome to see)!
* Be patient - I'm doing this alone, so it takes longer than I would like to

Thank you for all the support! I'll keep you updated!

notes.title: Update: 1HP game mode
notes.notes:
This is a risky 4AM update and a first part of my task list for this week.

I added a new game mode, where your piglet will have only 1 HP. It also has a leaderboard, so get your rage on, because in that mode you are more likely to notice various game design and hitbox issues.

Smaller things:
fixed large rank numbers getting out of the highscore box, removed "R" button functionality, projectiles shouldn't stick to the enemies after death, kill counter should not increase after death, also added buttons leading to my mobile games if you'd like to check them out. Iron Snout does have mobile versions too, but that's a pretty old build. 

Finally updated Mac version too!

Let me know what is broken. Hopefully, not a lot. I also hope, that achievement glitches will be less frequent now. Really hope so. They're driving me crazy. See you tomorrow!

notes.title: Achievement bugs + UPDATE
notes.notes:
UPDATE:
* added "clear stats" button (press STATISTICS in the main menu, it'll be at the top) if you had weird stat numbers or multiple random achievements and would like to gain all of them or maybe just try everything out again

I'm really sorry if you had to deal with that and lose progress! Therefore adding some new stuff as an apology:

* added combo leaderboard 
* added 3 new achievements (Rain of Hooves, BeckHAM, Beat 200)

* reduced strikes needed for "Many Punch Pig" to 25000
* fixed a "bug", where pressing space would reset your kill count

Also, to taunt: press direction pig is facing, hold for 0.5s and release!


----
Previous original text:

Lately I've had a couple of reports about ...

[olist]
     people stats getting set to a NASA-grade numbers
     only total kills are getting set to NASA-grade numbers
     achievement progress not updating 
     getting ton of achievements instantly (related to 1)
     not getting an achievement they deserve
[/olist]

What I did was...

Change some settings for live achievements and stats to avoid having stats reset when there's a connection problem and... I might have broke things. And it feels awful.

Please, write a comment if you have any of those issues above and let me know if it happened in the first-ever run of the game Also, let me know if none of that happened, that might make me feel better.

Sorry :(


Edit: it seems that not only discussions, but news comments are broken too, so no one can really respond to this now. I'm pretty certain, that I didn't break this part of Steam.
